$description: ArtPanel component contract (visual-3 V2) — art background under a theme-invariant dark scrim so text-on-art stays legible on every shell theme. Scrim colors use the pinned `surface.art` role: art surfaces are authored-dark, the panel never trusts themed surfaces under artwork.

scrim.$comment: deep scrim stop — toward the content edge

scrimSoft.$comment: light scrim stop — keeps art visible

edge.$comment: inner top highlight — glass edge on art
